description: This file defines onboarding states and connection modes for an application, including functions to determine onboarding flow and update onboarding status via UserDefaults.

methods.name: shouldPresentOnLaunch
methods.description: Determines whether the onboarding should be presented when the app launches, based on onboarding completion status, last gateway connection, and app model's gateway server name.

methods.name: markCompleted
methods.description: Marks the onboarding process as completed and records the mode and timestamp.

methods.name: shouldPresentFirstRunIntro
methods.description: Checks if the first run introduction should be shown, based on whether it was previously seen.

methods.name: markFirstRunIntroSeen
methods.description: Marks that the first run introduction has been viewed.

methods.name: markIncomplete
methods.description: Resets the onboarding status to incomplete.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets onboarding completion and first run intro seen status.

methods.name: lastMode
methods.description: Retrieves the last connection mode from UserDefaults if available.
